text:
maria: Starting an isolation onramp checklist for long-term routing + multi-region tenancy. Need concrete launch gates and prioritized customer asks. Short reactions.
kevin: SLA tiers first. My proposal: fast (p99<=120ms), balanced (p99<=250ms), cheap (p99<=500ms). Tie lanes to pricing.
sanjay: Isolation modes: shared, soft-slice (namespaces + token quotas), hard-slice (dedicated infra). I'll add infra multiplier estimates (1.0 / 1.2 / 1.4).
lisa: Customer note: banking and health prospects require EU residency + VPC + audit logs. Likely hard-slice ask.
noah: Policy DSL sketch: selectors, slo, fallbacks, canary. Example: ```policy {id: "lane/fast" slo: "p99<=120ms" fallback: "lane/balanced" canary:{pct:5 dur:"10m"}}```
emma: Propose an isolation_score (0-100) combining tail variance, cache churn, and error spikes. Thresholds: <30 shared, 30-70 soft, >70 hard.
oliver: Ops: add migration runbook and "erosion window" to avoid double billing when cutover. Also require e2e traffic replays for validation.
maria: Draft launch gates: SLA matrix, policy DSL v0 + tests, isolation_score telemetry in sample tenants, migration playbook, cost bands validated. I'll draft PRD and owners. Wed sync 09:30.
kevin: I'll deliver SLA matrix Tue EOD.
sanjay: I'll attach cost + ops burden numbers Thu.
lisa: I'll confirm top enterprise asks and residency specifics.
maria: Thanks all, will circulate PRD link when ready.
